description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for the git rebase functionality, including setup commands, test scenarios, expected outcomes, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for the given command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for negative test scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares two revision states or commit hashes for equality.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares outputs or states for equality.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that might fail, but doesn't cause the test to fail outright.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock to ensure different commit timestamps.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in file outputs.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all test cases.
